summary: Four of six seats returned schema-valid reviews of plan r1 (claude, codex, kimi, glm); all four asked for revision. Qwen exited nonzero and Gemini returned no JSON, so neither contributes an opinion. Two groups are rated high: the trust boundary of an exempt include (D3) and the predicate of the first-document exception (D4). Three more groups reach two supporters: VG1's machine-dependent bounds, the missing D2 (b) branch, and one citation. Twelve concerns have one supporter each; R0.4's wording is raised by kimi alone and, as a secondary remark, inside one claude concern.

agreed_concerns.title: The include exemption lets an unattended root carry unreviewed claims as if reviewed
agreed_concerns.summary: D3 (a) exempts every included element from U2-U6 and U8, but standalone include validation establishes validity, not review: a file the unattended host writes itself can carry confirmed, explicit or alethic claims. The section 6 control (attribution lines and pins) reports the include and does not establish that an owner reviewed it.

agreed_concerns.title: D4's 'owns no element' predicate for the U1 exception is under-defined
agreed_concerns.summary: The exception names object types, fact types and constraints. It does not say how ownership is decided on a composed document, whether an attached constraint counts, whether operations and obligations count, or that the reviewer half of U1 stays in force. VG4-C3 tests none of these boundaries.

agreed_concerns.title: VG1's absolute wall-clock bounds depend on the machine
agreed_concerns.summary: VG1-C2, C3 and C5 are thresholds in seconds calibrated from one laptop, once. Both reviewers ask for a machine-independent invariant (a ratio or a call count) as the required gate, with the absolute bound relative to a same-run baseline or in an opt-in lane.

agreed_concerns.title: A D2 (b) ruling leaves VG2 and VG5 unspecifiable as written
agreed_concerns.summary: Section 3 carries the D3 (b) branch forward but not the D2 (b) branch. VG2-C1 and VG5's round 2 use a new sample constraint, which _enforce_d12 keeps refusing under (b).

agreed_concerns.title: H13's line range anchors U5 and not U8
agreed_concerns.summary: H13 cites _unattended.py:56 and :211-222 for both U5 and U8; the U8 constant is at :58 and the check at :229-234.

prioritized_fixes.title: State the trust boundary of an exempt include and narrow or count what it carries
prioritized_fixes.action: Decide in the plan what makes an include exempt (for example a declared non-none reviewer in the included file, or keeping U8 for included constraints that are not confirmed), widen the attribution counts beyond confirmed, add a VG3 criterion for an included file that carries an unconfirmed alethic constraint, and state the remaining trust assumption in section 6 as a named limit.

prioritized_fixes.title: Define the U1 exception over the whole root-authored claim surface
prioritized_fixes.action: Define 'owns' by the same origin test VG3 uses, count attached constraints, operations and obligations, say that reviewer: none stays required, and add VG4-C3 cases at each boundary.

prioritized_fixes.title: Settle U7 for included elements and test every U rule on root-owned elements
prioritized_fixes.action: List U7 in the D3 exemption for spans an included element carries, and extend VG3-C2 and VG3-C3 to one root-owned case each for U6, U7 and U8, with the U8 case on a constraint attached to an included fact type.

prioritized_fixes.title: Correct the compatibility statement for unattended include roots that validate today
prioritized_fixes.action: Remove the claim that the current release admits no unattended include root, decide whether an included span naming a root-declared document is still re-hashed, and pin the validate output of a root the current release admits.

prioritized_fixes.title: Carry the D2 (b) branch into sections 3 and 4
prioritized_fixes.action: Add the D2 (b) variant of VG2's criteria and of VG5's round 2 beside the D3 (b) note.

prioritized_fixes.title: Make VG1's required gates machine-independent and name its oracle and corpus
prioritized_fixes.action: Make the ratio and the call count the required gates and state where the absolute bounds run, name the frozen reference VG1-C1 compares against, name src/gnd/examples as the corpus, and give D9's measurement a criterion and a conditional home.

prioritized_fixes.title: Make the attribution promise match what the criteria show
prioritized_fixes.action: Either add a per-element attribution output or reword the VG3 predicate to per-include lines plus diagnostic prefixes, say why validate-only attribution is enough or extend it, and restate VG3-C8 as a test with a reachable producer.

prioritized_fixes.title: Add the U1 tests to VG4 and reconcile the lint gate with project.md
prioritized_fixes.action: Add tests/test_unattended_mode.py to VG4's homes and lane, re-measure whole-repository ruff and record which statement is stale in D11.

prioritized_fixes.title: Repair R0.4's wording and H13's citation
prioritized_fixes.action: Rewrite R0.4's second sentence and extend H13's citation to :58 and :229-234.
